name: Guoguang Electric Company Limited
summary: Guoguang Electric Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the audio and electroacoustic, and lithium battery businesses in Mainland China, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers loudspeakers, bluetooth speakers, traditional headphones, computer peripheral audio, Wi-Fi speakers, soundbar, smart speakers, AI glasses, AI headphones, VR/AR products, car amplifiers, AVAS, car speakers, and subwoofers. It also provides lithium battery products for headphones, smart speakers, wearable devices, electronic cigarettes, drones, and other products. In addition, the company is involved in the rental of houses and buildings. Guoguang Electric Company Limited…
